effective_configuration.aot_policy: produce: resident Wasm bytes through Compile and MarshalBinary; load only those locally produced immutable bytes via LoadTrustedArtifact and verify behavior outside production timer; load: LoadTrustedArtifact of resident bytes generated by this adapter before sampling, behavior verified outside timer; no arbitrary native artifact ingestion; release outside timers
effective_configuration.app_init_release_policy: close verified instance; compiled module and host runtime retained; no forced GC
effective_configuration.compile_module_byte_limit: exact workload artifact size; Wago's 64 MiB default does not reject larger benchmark artifacts
effective_configuration.component_compile_cache: retained only within a feature timing request
effective_configuration.component_model: wago-org/component-model v0.1.6 loaded through Wago plugin contract
effective_configuration.counter_first_call_policy: fresh initialized instance per sample; compiled module retained; exactly one requested call, no hidden verification pre-call; setup/input/export resolution before counter window, verification/result copy/release after; no memory instrumentation
effective_configuration.counter_policy: core exact scalar compile/instantiate phase handshakes; one operation, no warmup; no allocator snapshots; perf collected externally over cgroup barrier window including transport/background work; verification and release excluded
effective_configuration.counter_steady_policy: stateless exact scalar; fresh compiled module/initialized instance per request retained across explicit warmup and measured batches; every call result copied into preallocated storage inside window and verified afterward; no hidden pre-call or memory snapshots; raw counts per batch include result capture and barrier transport
effective_configuration.density_policy: Runtime.Compile/Instantiate: fresh simultaneous group; shared_module one runtime/module; separate_engines fresh runtime and compilation per instance; timer includes engine construction, compile, instantiate/start, initialization, input and workload invocation; verification and release excluded; release waits Runtime.CloseContext and Module.Close; no forced GC
effective_configuration.execution_result_capture: copy each instance-owned Invoke result into preallocated storage before next call; capture cost included in execution window; oracle verification afterward
effective_configuration.harness_calibration_policy: empty-local-harness-v1: timing only; resident stateless core scalar workload checked before sampling; preallocated uint64-equivalent slots; timed local loop writes iteration+1 to every slot without Wasm/embedding calls; every slot verified after timer; no warmup, barriers or memory instrumentation; sample result is iteration count, not guest output; no automatic subtraction or performance scoring
effective_configuration.host_callback_policy: Owned typed callbacks retain signature/store/lifetime checks; proven pure Go i32 leaf arithmetic may lower into native trampolines on ARM64; threads-opaque-identity-v1 calls a noinline Go helper and retains Go transitions
effective_configuration.instantiate_release_policy: close verified instance; compiled module and host runtime retained; host-runtime Module handle prepared outside instantiation; no forced GC
effective_configuration.native_code_export: raw native image v1; mixed instructions/wrappers/embedded data; function attribution unavailable; maximum 16 MiB
effective_configuration.runtime_config: Wago defaults; thread profiles enable threads with explicit bounds; maxModuleBytes follows the prepared artifact
effective_configuration.teardown_policy: verify each fresh instance before timing instance and compiled-module close; host runtime retained; no forced GC
effective_configuration.vector_first_call_phases_policy: fresh initialized instance; pointers and first input prepared before before_first_call; first_call_returned follows last ordered call before its output oracle; memory window includes intercase input writes and oracle checks, unlike sequence_call_sum timers; final oracle and verified instance release follow returned barrier; compiled module retained; no forced reclamation
effective_configuration.vector_instantiate_phases_policy: fresh instance; prepared compiled module retained; instantiation includes Wasm start; explicit initialization, ordered vector calls, oracle verification and release outside API window; no forced GC
effective_configuration.wasi_preview1: wago-org/wasi v0.3.1 P1 provider host imports; explicit readonly fixture mount and guest argv/streams
effective_configuration.wasi_preview2: wago-org/wasi v0.3.1 P2 host options through the Component Model plugin service
